text:
"I would like to share my personal experience during my dental treatment at this clinic. I have no intention of damaging the clinic's reputation; I only want to share my feelings as information for potential patients.

I have been an orthodontic patient at this clinic for a long time and have also recommended friends to come here. My initial orthodontic treatment went well, but along the way, there were some points that made me feel insecure, so I'd like to share my personal experience.

1. Regarding filling gaps between my front teeth:
During my most recent filling, the color of the filling didn't match my natural tooth color. When I showed it to another clinic, they said the shade didn't quite match, which might be an unsuitability specific to my case.
When I asked the original dentist to remove it, I felt they weren't happy, and after removal, I felt my tooth structure looked different from before, which caused me concern.
When I showed the dentist before pictures of my teeth, they said my teeth were "worse" before, which made me feel uneasy.
All of this is just my personal feeling; it doesn't mean the clinic's service is bad, but it might just not be suitable for my case.

2. Regarding orthodontic appointments and costs:
Initially, I was treated by a different dentist, with appointments scheduled for Saturdays and Sundays." It was convenient. Later, the appointment was changed to Thursday, which clashed with my classes, so I couldn't go. This resulted in a change of doctor.
This might be more of a misunderstanding between the service provider and the patient; I'm not blaming anyone.

Regarding the cost information, I initially thought I hadn't paid for the full program, but after checking, I found I had paid in full and even overpaid by approximately 3,000 baht, which the counter staff didn't inform me of initially.
Finally, the clinic stated that they could not refund the excess amount because I had missed some appointments (due to the appointment time change), which may have been a misunderstanding.

In summary,
this is just my personal experience, and I'm not seeking any compensation. I just want the clinic to listen to my feedback to improve their communication, information dissemination, and explanations to patients.
I hope this is helpful for those seeking information. 🙏🏻

text: I had a terrible experience. They changed doctors without telling me. There was no warning that the promotion wasn't valid; it was a complete forced payment. They're charging 1000 baht a month until I'm satisfied and the braces are removed. I'm so confused. They didn't tell me when it would end; do I have to keep paying like this forever? And I'm not a doctor, how am I supposed to know if my teeth are in place and what the "until I'm satisfied" process means? I'm so confused.
